final:
I attempted to rename #payments-ops (ID: C_OPS) to "Payments Ops", but the Slack API returned the error `invalid_name_specials`. Slack channel names can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores — spaces and capital letters are not allowed. The requested name "Payments Ops" contains both, so it cannot be applied.

Note that the channel's current normalized name is already "payments-ops", which is exactly the valid form of "Payments Ops" that Slack permits. Therefore the channel is already named in the only valid way this name can appear in Slack. No rename could be applied as literally requested.
